text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So exciting and thrilling!☆ What will I be 
doing three years from now 
WATCHIIIIIIIIING!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Three years in the future for Orfe... Oh! 
Is this a post-race press conference? 
She's surrounded by reporters, same as 
ever~.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
For a king, reigning at the pinnacle is 
only natural.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Gentil's future three years from now 
is—oh! A victory celebration party? 
Sparkly as ever, I see~.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
For those who are strong, this is only 
natural.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Me? ...Heh. Guess I can't pretend to be a 
supermarket fish fillet in front of you 
guys after all.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wakashi, Inada, Warasa... I've been called 
by many names up until now. But—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"I'm actually a full-grown yellowtail!! In 
three years, I'll easily cross an ocean or 
two—no, five or six of 'em!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"It'd be totally boring if people thought 
this era belonged only to you guys!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Oh? To think you'd talk back like that.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's the spirit. Only then is it 
truly worth wielding my power.
